name: patient_sex_is_male_at_birth
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's sex assigned at birth is male.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's sex assigned at birth is male.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's sex assigned at birth is not male (e.g., female, other, unknown).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's sex assigned at birth is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_advanced_prostate_cancer_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer in their medical history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever been diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer at any point in their medical history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never been diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer at any point in their medical history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever been diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer in their medical history.
